itens.trecho: Português Seria mais interessante como filme de animação Este filme conta a história de Charlie, uma criança de origens modestas que ganha um bilhete de ouro que lhe dá a possibilidade de visitar a fábrica de chocolate do excêntrico Willie Wonka, cuja história também é contada através do filme.
Gene Wilder's interpretation of "Willy Wonka" was always going to be tough to top, and though he does try to inject some individuality to the role, Johnny Depp doesn't really compare so well.

Not as good as the original but still good nonetheless. Johnny Depp is really the only reason this movie was good. I think any other actor that would have played that character would have made the movie suck.
